title: Resolution urging Albany to fund free legal aid for military families
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass and the Governor to sign S.4529/A.164, creating a statewide Military Pro Bono Program within the Interest on Lawyer Account Fund to give free legal help to active-duty service members and their families. The program would cover civil, family, estate, employment, immigration and other legal matters, overseen by an advisory committee under the Attorney General. As of June 2026, New York has about 28,596 active-duty service members, 9,596 spouses and 14,086 children who could benefit.
